brief.prompt:
Use case: ads-marketing.
Create ONE finished Japanese editorial basketball article thumbnail as a PNG, landscape 16:9, 1792x1008 pixels or larger. This is for バスケまとめ.
Style direction: approved black-and-lime sports ink poster. Near-black #151A18 background, neon lime #CCF43B brush strokes, warm ivory Japanese lettering, orange basketball. Thick expressive hand-painted brush and scratchy ink textures, premium restrained sports editorial design, few elements, punchy clear hierarchy. Huge bold Japanese sans-serif headlines with clean readable glyphs; distressed ink confined mostly to illustration and brush accents.
Article is a multi-game roundup for 2026-10-26 in B.PREMIER and actual single-day EFF rankings by officially registered positions. Not a profile of a player. Illustrate no people, no faces, no hands. Right third: one large orange basketball rendered as hand-drawn ink illustration with a few abstract basketball court lines behind it and a diagonal lime brush gesture. This is a symbolic composition, not a real shot or a depiction of a decisive match moment.
Layout: left 64 percent is typography, right 36 percent is basketball illustration. Strong negative space behind all words. Keep all text at least 60 pixels inside canvas. Footer must be clearly legible, at least 26 pixels high at 1792px width. No overlap or clipping. No logos, team crests, sponsors, jerseys, scores or player names. Do not carry text, dates, scores, or persons from any prior example into this image.
Render these exact Japanese text strings ONCE each, in the specified hierarchy:
Top left small brand: "バスケまとめ"
Below brand, clear date and scope: "2026.10.26 ｜ B.PREMIER"
Main headline, largest ivory text: "10/26 試合結果"
Second large line, lime: "当日のEFF"
Third line, bold ivory with lime emphasis on TOP3: "ポジション別 TOP3"
Small bottom informational line: "公式記録は訂正される場合があります"
Bottom disclosure line, clearly readable: "イラスト（AI生成）　成績をもとにしたイメージ"
The main headline may be two typographic lines with "10/26" over "試合結果" if that makes it larger and better balanced, but retain every exact character. Keep the EFF line and TOP3 subtitle distinct and visibly subordinate to 試合結果. The typography must read cleanly when reduced to a web thumbnail.
Do not add any other text. EFF is the actual day-only official feed statistic, not season averages, predictions, overall MVP, definitive all-position top-three, or starting lineup. Use the original exact Japanese lettering and spell EFF and TOP3 correctly.
